citation: Hoey (2016), Evaluation of High Temperature Performance of Co-Cr-C Coated P92 Steel
material_condition: Uncoated DB P92, one supplied pipe section; austenitised approximately 1070 C, tempered approximately 775 C; approximately 2 h pre-test warm-up

fatigue_protocol.waveform: zero-to-positive triangular strain; tensile dwell at peak when specified
fatigue_protocol.failure_definition: fracture or stress drop greater than 50 percent
fatigue_protocol.source_strain_semantics: peak equals range; amplitude and mean are half the reported percent strain

constants_units: stress in MPa, time in hours; strain interpretation must be audited, not silently rescaled
validation_role: Visually checked numerical transcription and fixed published coefficient reproduction; not independent validation or an engineering allowable
limitations: No raw within-hold relaxation history admitted
Do not substitute fully reversed fatigue coefficients
Source constants fitted these creep observations; not held out
